changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'EventRegistration') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[EventRegistration]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [TypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [ChangeType] [int] NOT NULL, [Condition] [xml] NULL, [Settings] [xml] NULL, [LastExecuted] [datetime] NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_WorkflowEventRegistration_State] DEFAULT (-1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_WorkflowEventRegistration] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowEventRegistration_WorkflowType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[EventRegistration] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowEventRegistration_WorkflowType] FOREIGN KEY([TypeID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[Type] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [workflow].[EventRegistration] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowEventRegistration_WorkflowType] END

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
IF not EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_EventRegistration_object_objectid_state') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_EventRegistration_object_objectid_state] ON [Workflow].[EventRegistration] ([object] ASC,[objectid] ASC,[state] ASC) END
IF not EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_EventRegistration_typeid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_EventRegistration_typeid] ON [Workflow].[EventRegistration] ([typeid] ASC) END
changeSet.rollback:
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_EventRegistration_object_objectid_state') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_EventRegistration_object_objectid_state] ON [Workflow].[EventRegistration] END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_EventRegistration_typeid') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_EventRegistration_typeid] ON [Workflow].[EventRegistration] END
